item.title: Advocacy Intern (m/f/d)
item.description: We are seeking an enthusiastic, self-motivated, and highly organised Advocacy Intern. Someone who is passionate about European foreign policy and European politics and has an interest in gaining experience in advocacy and campaigning. The Advocacy Intern supports the activities of ECFR’s Central Advocacy Team, which supports the launching of the organisation’s flagship initiatives. The intern will gain insight into the rollout of pan-European advocacy and outreach strategies at an important juncture for Europe’s role in the world. The intern will be involved in all daily tasks of the Central Advocacy Team, helping in the organisation of a range of research, advocacy, and events. They will learn to work in a fast-paced office environment requiring extensive interactions with others. The intern will develop knowledge and skills within a think tank context and in the field of foreign policy and international relations. Assist with the organisation of high-level conferences and meetings for ECFR policy staff. Undertake research tasks to inform the rollout of the advocacy and outreach strategy Assist in the drafting of advocacy documents and briefing notes Assist in the tracking, monitoring and evaluation of the advocacy and outreach strategy Update databases and other contacts to ensure accurate, up-to-date records. Other general responsibilities may be reasonably requested over time. Other general tasks may be reasonably requested over time. Currently enrolled as a (Master's or 3rd-year Bachelor's) student in a related field of study such as International Relations, European Studies, Politics, Journalism, Communications, or equivalent High IT proficiency, MS-Office and social media, as well as Zoom. Knowledge of Canva is a bonus. Excellent written and oral communication in English. German or another European language is an advantage. Creator of compelling visual documents Understanding of EU and governance institutions, especially in the foreign policy realm Understanding of EU international relations and interest in foreign policy. Can-do approach, flexible and able to multitask and prioritize as needed Proactive and high degree of organizational skills Ability to work independently and as part of a multinational, virtual team and to develop effective working relationships Detail-oriented, reliable, and quality-driven Full-time Internship Contract (3 months) with a stipend amounting to 603 EUR/month. Convenient office location in the heart of Berlin Stimulating and open work culture at an innovative and renowned pan-European think tank with partly hybrid work opportunities that allow flexibility while maintaining productivity and collaboration. Opportunity to collaborate with highly motivated and committed colleagues from diverse backgrounds across Europe, within an organization that holds a distinguished position and wide recognition within the think tank world. If this is of interest, we look forward to receiving your application! Closing Date: 13th August 2026, 09:00 am CET Please use the apply button to submit your cover letter and CV in English (max. 2 pg. and PDF format) Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany. We are looking for someone to be available for 3 months from October 2026 until December 2026 (it is also possible to join from mid-September for 3 months). Due to the volume of applications we receive, we will only be able to respond to candidates after the application deadline has passed. We appreciate your patience and understanding. We care about your data privacy. If you are interested to know more about how we manage your personal data, you can find more information in this link: https://ecfr.eu/privacy-job-applicants/ ECFR is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we do not discriminate against applicants due to race, ethnicity, gender, veteran status, or on the basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. STRICTLY NO AGENCIES PLEASE

item.title: Berlin Office & Events Intern (m/f/d)
item.description: The purpose of the internship is to provide practical support for event logistics and general administration in ECFR’s Berlin office. The intern will support events organised by the Berlin office and ECFR programmes in Berlin, including the Berlin Foreign Policy Club, Black Coffee Mornings, lunch events, and the DARE conference in December. The role will focus primarily on logistical preparation, on-site coordination, follow-up administration, and day-to-day office support. Event logistics support: Assist with the practical organisation and delivery of events hosted at ECFR’s Berlin office, including the Berlin Foreign Policy Club, Black Coffee Mornings, lunch events, and other events organised by ECFR programmes in Berlin. Tasks may include preparing guest lists, tracking RSVPs, liaising with participants and service providers, preparing rooms and materials, supporting catering arrangements, welcoming guests, and helping with on-site coordination and follow-up. DARE conference support : Provide logistical and administrative support for the DARE conference in December, including preparation of participant and speaker information, coordination of event materials, assistance with travel and accommodation logistics where needed, support for internal planning lists, and on-site assistance before and during the event. CRM Management: A ssist with maintaining the CRM system and support the network engagement and communication efforts of the Berlin office . Administrative and Office Support: Support the Office Manager and Berlin office team with day-to-day administrative tasks, including answering the phone, responding to emails sent to the general inbox, receiving deliveries, processing or tracking office-related requests, supporting orders for supplies, and assisting with other practical office tasks as needed. Team Collaboration: Work closely with the Office Manager, the Berlin office team, and programme colleagues to ensure smooth event delivery and office operations. Provide flexible support for practical tasks and urgent needs, particularly in the run-up to larger events. Occasional research support: Support ad hoc research-related tasks where needed, such as background searches, short summaries, and preparation of materials for research papers, briefings, or speaking engagements. Other general tasks may be reasonably requested over time. Current Bachelor's (3rd year onwards) or Master's student in Political Science, International Relations, Public Administration , Social Sciences, or a related discipline. Previous experience in event support, hospitality or customer-facing work would be an advantage. Strong interest in international affairs and the work of ECFR, combined with a practical, service-oriented approach for supporting events and office operations. Proficiency in written and spoken English (C1) and German (minimum B1 level) . Organizational Skills: Well-organized, with the ability to multitask effectively, prioritize responsibilities, and maintain attention to detail. Proactivity and Flexibility : Proactive, self-motivated, and flexible, able to work both independently and as part of a multinational team. Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication skills, with ease in drafting invitations, engaging in social interactions, and presenting ideas. Comfortable working in a multicultural environment and able to adapt communication styles accordingly. Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experienced in using tools like CRM systems and WordPress. Reliability and Quality Focus : Detail-oriented, reliable, and committed to delivering high-quality work with a positive attitude. Teamwork and Management: Capable of managing tasks efficiently, prioritizing and multitasking in a fast-paced environment, with strong interpersonal and social skills that contribute to team success. Full-time Internship Contract (3 months) with a stipend amounting to 603 EUR/month. Convenient office location in the heart of Berlin Stimulating and open work culture at an innovative and renowned pan-European think tank with partly hybrid work opportunities that allow flexibility while maintaining productivity and collaboration. Opportunity to collaborate with highly motivated and committed colleagues from diverse backgrounds across Europe, within an organization that holds a distinguished position and wide recognition within the think tank world. If this is of interest, we look forward to receiving your application! Closing Date: 21st August 2026, 09:00 am CET Please use the apply button to submit your cover letter and CV in English (max. 2 pg. and PDF format) Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany. We are looking for someone to be available for 3 months from mid-September 2026 until mid-December 2026.
